description:
An agent printed `~/.pi/agent/mcp.json` while investigating why MCP tools were missing, which
wrote the denops bearer token into the session transcript (`~/.pi/agent/sessions/…jsonl`) as well
as the terminal scrollback. Reported by the agent, 2026-11-03.

Blast radius is small — loopback behind Caddy on a private domain, and the token already lived in
plaintext in `mcp.json` and `secrets.json` on the same machine — but it is now in one more place,
including a conversation log that may be shared or synced.

## Rotation

- [ ] generate a new token (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 48 | tr -d '\n'`)
- [ ] set it as `serverToken` in `/home/freebox/denops/secrets.json` (mode 600, gitignored)
- [ ] restart denops (`data/restart-request`, or the supervisor restart; a promote is not needed)
- [ ] update `~/.pi/agent/mcp.json` → `headers.Authorization`
- [ ] update every external client that holds it: the Mistral Vibe connector (OAuth
      `client_credentials`), other MCP clients, and any script with the token baked in
- [ ] verify: unauthenticated `/mcp` → 401 **with** the RFC 9728 challenge; authenticated → 200;
      `POST /oauth/token` (`grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id=mistral`, secret = new
      token) → 200 and the access token equals it

## Note

The OAuth client secret **is** the bearer token (`server.oauth.clientId: mistral` in config), so
rotation invalidates any cached access token at its next use, and the `ttlSec: 3600` window means
a client can keep working for up to an hour on the old value. Rotate both sides together.

## Prevent the recurrence

- [ ] do not `cat` credential files into a prompt; grep for the key name and its length instead
- [ ] consider `server.tokenFile` (supported by config) so the token is never inlined in client
      config files
title: security: rotate the denops bearer token (exposed in a session transcript, 2026-11-03)

description:
Everything a *new* session needs that is not in `SKILL.md` (which describes the served
surface) nor in `AGENTS.md` (which describes the repo). Learned the hard way on 2026-11-03.

## Tool registration is decided when the session starts

`~/.pi/agent/mcp.json` points at `https://wdmn.hd.free.fr/mcp`. pi registers an MCP server's
tools at session open, and **never again**. On 2026-11-03 a session opened at 09:14 while the
server was 502ing (crash loop 09:10:53 → 09:20). Consequence: `mcp__denops` was absent for the
whole session even after the server came back — `ALL_TOOLS` had 11 entries and
`searchTools()` returned `[]`, so every denops call was made by hand:

```
ssh homelab → read serverToken from secrets.json → curl the JSON-RPC endpoint
```

**If a session opens while denops is unreachable, restart the session after fixing it.**

Also: denops exposes four MCP tools (`search`, `execute`, `approve`, `grants`); the 74 ops are
code inside `execute`. Without a declared `approve`, an approval-tier op can only reach
`awaiting_approval` — that is why 0.4.0…0.5.1 were promoted by writing the state files (see !10)
and issues were filed through the GitLab API directly.

## State as of 2026-11-03T11:00Z

- live `0.5.1` @ `5682416`; `main` == `origin/main` == the laptop checkout; `denops.service` active.
- `/health` → `{"ok":true,"degraded":["mail"]}`: `amu`'s IMAP backend is down upstream
  (`No DC server listening`), `free` is healthy. Tracking + fixes in !12.
- `proton` is commented out of the live `config.yaml` (no Proton Bridge on that host, and the
  startup probe for it is what took the whole server down before 0.4.0 — see CHANGELOG).
- `caldav` is enabled with one account, `icloud` / `mmwoodman@icloud.com`, Basic + app password
  from `secrets.calendar.icloud.password`. Event writes are approval-tier; reminders are live.
- no tmux on that host (stale socket only); logs are `data/server.log` + journald. See !11.

## Client-side credentials

`~/.pi/agent/mcp.json` holds the bearer token in plaintext; it is the same value as
`secrets.serverToken`. They have to be rotated together — tracked as a `security` issue.

## Checklist

- [ ] bring `AGENTS.md` up to date with the layout, the promote path and this session-start rule,
      so the next agent does not need GitLab to find its bearings
- [ ] consider making `mcp.json` read the token from an env var or file instead of inlining it
- [ ] decide whether the iCloud app password stays provisioned (revoke at appleid.apple.com if
      caldav is not going to stay in use)
title: ops: what a fresh session needs to know — tool registration, live state snapshot, client credentials
